caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a skirt, centered on a plain, off-white background. The skirt is predominantly brown with a gathered waistband at the top, creating vertical pleats in the fabric. Along both vertical sides and extending to the hem is an ornate floral border featuring intricate yellow or gold flowers and leafy patterns on a darker brown background. The floral designs are repeated and symmetrical along the borders, and a larger floral motif appears at the bottom hemline, centrally positioned. There are no other objects or details in the background, and the artist's name, "David P. Willoughby," is inscribed in small print on the lower right portion of the page.
title: Apron
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
